scope: Bounded shapes implementation research/provenance ledger; neighboring public behavior retained with explicit dispositions. This is not whole API parity.
notice: Existing test-case-map-notice.txt and upstream-license-notice.txt retain required research notices; implementation uses original wording/assets.

selection.policy: All collected parameter variants and expanded examples from selected files are retained exactly once, including neighboring unsupported public behavior.

geometry: Read each coordinate independently; absent is null, explicit zero overrides inheritance.
Store finite safe integer EMUs; convert units once with ties away from zero, positive extents and signed positions.
Updating a coordinate retains siblings and schema order.
identity: Allocate an unused positive ID within the owning drawing tree; expose shape_id as read-only.
Round-trip empty and XML-sensitive names; names do not rename package parts or identify global objects.
preset: Create text boxes and supported preset geometry with original content and required schema children.
Unknown presets remain byte-preserved and reject unsupported semantic writes.
Inspect classification without adding missing text bodies; model text_frame creation is an explicit effect.
placeholder: Retain sparse idx keys, omitted idx=0 and omitted type=obj; ordinary shapes reject placeholder-only access.
Resolve layout/master inheritance per coordinate with explicit zero winning and unknown geometry remaining null.
Rich replacement invalidation and image/chart/table insertion remain separate public obligations.
fill: Absent fill inherits; noFill and explicit solid RGB remain distinct.
Replace only the known fill choice and preserve unrelated extension children in schema order.
Gradient/pattern/background access has separate contracts and is never silently coerced to solid.
line: Absent width, explicit zero and positive EMU widths remain distinguishable.
Line color and fill retain their documented creating-getter side effects; CLI inspection is noncreating.
Dash choices replace mutually exclusive choices in schema order; unsupported values fail without publication.
color: Assert literal RGB channels and XML token values with independent expected constants.
Absence and unsupported color kinds raise their documented property errors; no host palette lookup.
Theme and brightness retain explicit inheritance and bounded fractions.
adjustments: Preserve default-versus-explicit normalized guide values, including zero and negative values.
Reject out-of-range indexing and invalid assigned values; do not expose arbitrary formula evaluation.
collection: Preserve drawing-tree ordering, checked zero-based model access and one-based CLI slide selection.
Sparse placeholder keys are not sequence positions; ownership and allocated IDs remain local.
No arbitrary member evaluation or implicit host access.
other-public: Retain the exact source-row behavior as an explicit public coverage gap; no parity claimed for unrelated media, charts, effects, freeforms or actions.
